column2: Dehydration occurs when the body loses more fluid than it takes in. Symptoms can include thirst, dark urine, and dizziness. Severe symptoms require medical attention.

column1: What are common causes of a headache?
column2: Headaches can be associated with stress, dehydration, lack of sleep, or other conditions. A sudden extremely severe headache or one with weakness or confusion requires emergency care.

column1: How can I improve my sleep?
column2: Keep a regular sleep schedule, make your bedroom comfortable, and reduce caffeine late in the day. Seek professional advice for persistent sleep problems.
A balanced diet includes a variety of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, protein sources, and other foods in suitable proportions.
Drink fluids regularly throughout the day. Fluid needs vary with activity, weather, age, and health conditions.

column1: How can I prevent the spread of infections?
column2: Wash your hands regularly, follow appropriate respiratory hygiene, and stay up to date with recommended vaccinations.
Regular physical activity supports physical and mental health. Choose activities appropriate for your abilities and health status.

column1: What should I do for a minor burn?
column2: Cool a minor burn under cool running water for 20 minutes. Do not apply ice. Seek urgent medical care for serious burns or burns involving sensitive areas.

column1: What are signs of a stroke?
column2: Sudden facial drooping, weakness in an arm, or difficulty speaking can indicate a stroke. Call your local emergency number immediately.
